onboarding.title: Open an observation

units.heading: Unit system
units.description: Affects range rings, cross-section/RHI axes, distance to site (AWS download), and wind/rain readouts on hover. Palette thresholds and stored site coordinates/altitude stay in metric internally.

sites.heading: Saved site locations
sites.description: Position used for formats that don't carry their own georeference (NEXRAD L2, .obs), saved per site code.

palettes.byVariableDescription: Each variable is drawn with its assigned palette. Edit colors with the palette icon over the viewer; here you choose which palette each variable uses.
palettes.byProductDescription: Tops, VIL, rain and wind have their own physical unit and don't use the source variable's palette.

calc.heading: Rain-rate calculation constants
calc.description: Z-R coefficients (R = (Z/A)^(1/B)) used by default when opening a new rain-rate window. Each window can adjust them individually afterward.
calc.speckleDescription: Removes short isolated echo runs along each radial. Minimum continuous-echo distance to keep; 0 disables the filter.

view.heading: Default view
view.description: Values used when opening new windows -- each window can adjust them individually afterward.

siteLocationEditor.instructions: Pick the radar's location by clicking the map, or enter coordinates by hand.
siteLocationEditor.elevationUnavailable: Couldn't fetch automatic elevation (service unavailable). Enter the altitude by hand.

awsExplorer.searchHint: Search for the nearest radar by ZIP code (US), or pick it directly on the map.
